findings.evidence: `dirichletConductor` constructs only `Fintype Y` via `Fintype.ofFinite Y`, and `dirichletConductor_dvd_iff` likewise ranges over `Y`; no proof in lines 47–93 inspects or enumerates the ambient `DirichletCharacter R n`.
findings.fix: Put `[Finite Y]` on `dirichletConductor` and theorems about one subgroup, `[Finite Y] [Finite Z]` on monotonicity, and remove the target ambient-finiteness assumption from `dirichletConductor_map_ringHomComp`; retain stronger assumptions only on results such as `closure_singleton` if actually required.
findings.issue: The ambient assumption `[Finite (DirichletCharacter R n)]` unnecessarily excludes finite subgroups of infinite character groups; lines 47–93 only enumerate `Y`, and the map theorem similarly needs finiteness only of `Y` and its image.

summary: The subgroup-conductor API assumes the entire ambient character group is finite, although its construction and core laws only require the chosen subgroup to be finite.
